downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.55.0。选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.55.0. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: Mentor AI 设置新增「Custom (OpenAI-compatible)」数据源，可填入任意兼容 OpenAI 协议的 HTTPS 端点地址和模型名称。
highlights.en: Added a Custom (OpenAI-compatible) provider to Mentor AI settings — enter any OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint and model name.

highlights.zh: 资料库新增双滑块训练时间窗口选择器，可拖动设定起止时间；连续合约标签页设为默认首页。
highlights.en: Added a dual-handle range slider for training time selection in the library, and made continuous contracts the default tab.

highlights.zh: 新增券商服务器时区设置，可在会话信息中编辑服务器时钟；国内期货 M1 数据全面迁移至 Parquet v2 格式。
highlights.en: Added broker server timezone settings with an editable server clock, and migrated CN futures M1 data to the Parquet v2 format.

highlights.zh: 图表切换周期性能大幅优化：延迟聚合、分层粗周期缓存，切换时保留缩放比例和滚动位置。
highlights.en: Major chart timeframe-switch performance improvements: deferred aggregation, layered coarse-period cache, and preserved zoom and scroll position.

highlights.zh: 历史交易聚焦连线改为渐入动画，三段脉冲更醒目；明暗主题网格可见性提升。
highlights.en: Trade focus overlays now use a fade-in animation with triple pulse; improved grid visibility across light and dark themes.

highlights.zh: 修复回看复盘时切换周期丢失 K 线数量、持仓线菜单溢出图表、成交量在切换主题后不刷新、授权 OTP 请求超时等问题。
highlights.en: Fixed bar-count loss on timeframe switch during scroll-back, position-line menu overflow, volume not repainting on theme change, and licence OTP request timeouts.
